responsibility: This definition file declaratively builds the tree nodes and TREE_LIST chains that describe default attributes for GCC built-in functions. It centralizes reusable attribute identifiers, integer and string operands, and precomposed lists for properties such as nothrow, const, pure, malloc, nonnull, format, returns_nonnull, and transactional-memory variants, so builtin registration code can attach stable attribute sets without hand-constructing trees in C++.
